focus_areas: Ear feathering integrity and connection to head
Coat pattern definition (red vs white boundaries)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the dog's feathered ears/tail and the background. AI often blurs these fine details. Also, verify that the 'docking' of the tail looks anatomically plausible and not just cut off abruptly. Ensure the red patches are distinct and not bleeding into the white fur unnaturally.
image_description: A full-body profile shot of a Blenheim spaniel (Cavalier King Charles Spaniel) standing on a green grassy lawn. The dog features the characteristic white coat with rich chestnut/red patches, particularly on the ears and head spots. It has long, heavily feathered ears, a domed head, and a docked tail held level with the back. The image is framed by a decorative brown border.
